items.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
items.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

items.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
items.summary: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

items.title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
items.summary: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

items.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
items.summary: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

items.title: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
items.summary: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.

items.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
items.summary: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.
